document_title: Human Review Panel & Adjudication Governance Specification

reviewer_1.title: Primary Independent Blinded Adjudicator
reviewer_1.qualification: Certified safety systems engineer or industrial human factors specialist.
reviewer_1.independence: Evaluates raw multi-camera video and kinematic telemetry without knowledge of Reviewer 2, Lead Adjudicator, or automated model outputs.

reviewer_2.title: Secondary Independent Blinded Adjudicator
reviewer_2.qualification: Certified safety systems engineer or industrial robotics perception specialist.
reviewer_2.independence: Evaluates identical review package independently without access to Reviewer 1's ballot or intermediate ratings.

lead_adjudicator.title: Lead Consensus Arbitrator & Adjudication Supervisor
lead_adjudicator.authority: Arbitrates split ballots; verifies adherence to evidentiary criteria; signs final Ground Truth commitment manifest.

step_1_independent_blinded_review.description: Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 independently inspect sanitized packages (strictly stripped of AI scores, bounding boxes, track IDs, and Model H curves) and submit completed evaluation ballots.

step_2_inter_rater_agreement_calculation.description: The system computes Cohen's Kappa (kappa) across all categorical evaluation fields based solely on the independent ratings of Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 prior to any consultation or arbitration.
step_2_inter_rater_agreement_calculation.epistemic_limitation_declaration: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC PRINCIPLE: An inter-rater agreement of kappa >= 0.80 demonstrates high consensus reliability between human evaluators; it DOES NOT constitute mathematical or empirical proof that the agreed-upon label is an infallible physical truth.

step_3_adjudication_and_arbitration.description: Resolution of ballot outcomes according to strict decision logic.

decision_rules.action: Unanimous consensus established; Lead Adjudicator countersigns and certifies package.
Lead Adjudicator convenes blinded tie-breaker session, inspects discrepancies against the physical Evidence Contract, and renders a final binding adjudication label (SPLIT_ARBITRATED).

decision_rules.condition: Evidence remains ambiguous to all three evaluators
decision_rules.action: Package is assigned GT_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and cannot be claimed as positive or negative backfire.

step_4_ground_truth_commitment.description: The final adjudicated label is cryptographically committed with SHA-256 signatures of all participating evaluators.
step_4_ground_truth_commitment.state_transition: Advances dataset from DATASET_READY_FOR_REVIEW to VALIDATION_READY.

prohibited_adjudication_shortcuts: No single-reviewer Ground Truth assignment permitted.
No post-hoc modification of independent ballots after unblinding.
No algorithmic assistance or automated label pre-population in review forms.
